lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-intensity circular blobs arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits, with a notable cluster of larger, distinct maxima in the mid-lateral region above the pectoral fin.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal spot rows, forming a loose grid-like arrangement of high-luminance nodes across the mid-flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient where the dorsal edge of each ridge is high-luminance and the ventral edge is in shadow.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A prominent vertical linear feature, likely a scar or deep crease, is visible on the flank posterior to the branchial region; a small, dark, circular anomaly is present dorsally to the pectoral fin base.
other_distinctive_markers: High-luminance white patch located on the distal tip and leading edge of the pectoral fin, contrasting sharply with the surrounding gray-scale values.
